description: Source file implementing time zone parsing functions for POSIX time zone specifications within the absl::cctz namespace.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Parses an integer within specified bounds from a string.

methods.name: ParseAbbr
methods.description: Parses a timezone abbreviation, either in <...> format or as a string of at least 3 non-digit, non-sign characters.

methods.name: ParseOffset
methods.description: Parses a time offset in hours, minutes, and seconds, with sign, into seconds.

methods.name: ParseDateTime
methods.description: Parses a date/time specification in POSIX timezone format into a PosixTransition structure.

methods.name: ParsePosixSpec
methods.description: Parses a full POSIX timezone specification string into a PosixTimeZone structure.
